name: High Executor Darthalia
summary: At Tarren Mill, High Executor Darthalia directs the Forsaken war in Hillsbrad. Under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras, she targets Southshore and the Syndicate.

sections.title: Commander of Tarren Mill
sections.body: High Executor Darthalia commands Forsaken forces from Tarren Mill. She works to contain the human forces in Southshore and hunt the Syndicate brigands across the Hillsbrad Foothills. Every Forsaken offensive in southern Hillsbrad passes through her command.

sections.title: The War for Hillsbrad
sections.body: High Executor Darthalia follows orders from the Undercity's leaders, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras. She directs the war across Hillsbrad, with scouting, strikes against human leaders, and bounties on outlaws who threaten Forsaken control of northern Lordaeron.

faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia leads Forsaken forces in the Hillsbrad Foothills. She directs their efforts against Southshore and the Syndicate.
Darthalia commands Forsaken forces from Tarren Mill, coordinating troops and strikes across central Lordaeron.
Darthalia answers to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras, the Undercity's leaders.

faq.q: What tasks does Darthalia give to adventurers?
faq.answer: Darthalia sends Horde champions against human settlements and dangerous outlaws, including Syndicate members throughout the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why is Darthalia fighting the humans of Southshore?
faq.answer: Darthalia fights to contain Southshore's Alliance forces, protect Tarren Mill, and stop them from pushing north toward the Undercity.

faq.q: What is Darthalia's rank in the Forsaken military?
faq.answer: As a High Executor, Darthalia holds a high rank in the Forsaken military and commands regional forces, outposts, and war strategy in Hillsbrad.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you can see Darthalia's resolve to keep Lordaeron in undead hands.
As a Horde adventurer, you report to Darthalia to oppose the Alliance and hold Hillsbrad's contested frontier.
To Southshore's humans and their allies, Darthalia leads the assaults threatening their foothold in Lordaeron.
